mapper.sql: id, title, content, notice_type, publish_status, publisher_id, publish_time, top_flag, create_time, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM t_notice WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

SELECT
FROM t_notice WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND publish_status = 1 ORDER BY top_flag DESC, publish_time DESC, create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notice ( title, content, notice_type, publish_status, publisher_id, publish_time, top_flag, create_time, update_time, is_deleted ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{noticeType}, #{publishStatus}, #{publisherId}, #{publishTime}, #{topFlag}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, notice_type = #{noticeType}, publish_status = #{publishStatus}, publisher_id = #{publisherId}, publish_time = #{publishTime}, top_flag = #{topFlag}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE t_notice SET publish_status = #{publishStatus}, publisher_id = #{publisherId}, publish_time = CASE WHEN #{publishStatus} = 1 THEN NOW() ELSE publish_time END, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE t_notice SET is_deleted = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
